members.member:
A public static class that provides useful methods for working with PhysicsScenes in Unity.
Author: Mathew Aloisio

member.name: M:PhysicsSceneManagement.PhysicsSceneUtility.GetLocalPhysicsScene(UnityEngine.GameObject)
member.summary: Returns the most appropriate PhysicsScene returning pGameObject's local scene if valid, otherwise Physics.defaultPhysicsScene.
member.returns: the most appropriate PhysicsScene returning pGameObject's local scene if valid, otherwise Physics.defaultPhysicsScene.
